movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
movies.overview: With Gotham's mob on the back foot, Batman, Lieutenant Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent form an uneasy alliance. Their progress is upended when a chaotic new criminal calling himself the Joker sets out to prove that everyone can be corrupted.

movies.title: Inception
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movies.overview: Dom Cobb steals secrets from inside people's dreams. Offered a chance to erase his past, he assembles a team for the reverse task: planting an idea deep in a target's subconscious.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.overview: As crops fail across a dying Earth, a former pilot joins a small crew travelling through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity, leaving his children behind with no promise of return.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.overview: The ageing patriarch of a New York crime family hands control to his reluctant youngest son, who is drawn ever deeper into a world he wanted no part of.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean you have character.
movies.overview: Two hit men, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner bandits cross paths in a set of interlocking stories told out of order.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movies.overview: The struggling Kim family talk their way into the household of the wealthy Parks one job at a time, until an unexpected discovery threatens the arrangement.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.overview: Ten-year-old Chihiro wanders into a bathhouse for spirits, where a witch turns her parents into pigs. To free them she takes a job under a new name and must not forget her own.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.
movies.overview: A young hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to destroy it in the one place it can be unmade.

franchise.name: The Lord of the Rings Collection

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.overview: In a desert wasteland ruled by a warlord, a drifter and a rebellious lieutenant flee across the sand in an armoured rig with five escapees and an entire war party on their tail.

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.tagline: The toys are back in town.
movies.overview: When a flashy space-ranger toy arrives, a cowboy doll's place as the favourite is threatened. A scheme to get rid of the newcomer strands both of them far from home.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.overview: Paul Atreides joins the Fremen and rides to war against the Harkonnens, while a prophecy he does not trust gathers momentum around him.

shows.name: Breaking Bad
shows.overview: A chemistry teacher given a terminal diagnosis turns to cooking methamphetamine with a former student, telling himself it is all for his family.

shows.name: Game of Thrones
shows.overview: Noble houses fight for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient threat gathers beyond the Wall in the far north.

episodes.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

shows.name: Chernobyl
shows.tagline: What is the cost of lies?
shows.overview: A dramatisation of the 1986 nuclear disaster and the scientists, firefighters and miners who tried to contain it while officials worked to contain the truth.

shows.name: The Office
shows.overview: A documentary crew follows the staff of a paper company's Scranton branch and the regional manager who is certain he is everybody's best friend.

shows.name: Stranger Things
shows.overview: A boy vanishes from a small Indiana town, and his friends, family and the local police chief uncover a government lab, a girl with strange powers and a world beneath their own.

shows.name: Severance
shows.overview: Employees at a secretive corporation undergo a procedure that splits their work memories from their home lives, until one team starts asking what they actually do all day.

shows.name: Fleabag
shows.overview: A grieving, sharp-tongued Londoner narrates her own life straight to camera while trying to keep a café, a family and a string of bad decisions from falling apart.
